# Apache Magpie

> AI-powered assistant for open-source maintainers. Triage, mentor, draft, pair, and auto-merge under Apache Software Foundation governance.

Apache Magpie is a set of agent skills (recipes) that maintainers run inside
their own agent harness: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Cursor and
others. It is not a hosted service. There is no HTTP API, no OpenAPI spec and
nothing to call on this domain; integrate by installing the skills from the
source repository, or through an agent marketplace.

- Source repository: https://github.com/apache/magpie
- Agent contract for the source tree: https://github.com/apache/magpie/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- Contributing: https://github.com/apache/magpie/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
- Website source: https://github.com/apache/magpie-site
- Developer mailing list: dev@magpie.apache.org (archive: https://lists.apache.org/list.html?dev@magpie.apache.org)

Every documentation page has a Markdown twin at the same path with a `.md`
suffix in place of the trailing slash, for example
https://magpie.apache.org/docs/modes/ is also https://magpie.apache.org/docs/modes.md. HTML pages advertise
their twin with `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`. Prefer the
twin: it is the synced source with no navigation.

## Site

- [Home](https://magpie.apache.org/): What Magpie is, the five agentic modes, and the ten skill families.
- [Documentation](https://magpie.apache.org/docs/): Setup, skill families, education stream, principles and RFCs.
- [Architecture](https://magpie.apache.org/architecture/): Organizations, tools and capability contracts behind vendor neutrality.
- [Tools](https://magpie.apache.org/tools/): The adapters that fulfil each capability, and which vendors each supports.
- [Downloads](https://magpie.apache.org/downloads/): Signed release artifacts and how to verify them.
- [Brand assets](https://magpie.apache.org/brand/): Logos, wordmark and usage rules for the Apache Magpie trademark.
